results.criterion: With an available Surveyor layer loaded using its default configuration, opening Display Settings shows Show linked sites with a visibly identifiable checked or unchecked state, and the same layer is identifiable in the layer list or legend.
steps_taken: Navigated to exact launcher and captured initial state.
Opened GIS; no loaded layer was initially present.
Opened Surveyor add dialog; retained default Service, Last 30 days and filters; clicked Add layer.
Add-layer tool timed out awaiting tools/call after 120s, but subsequent screenshot and snapshot showed Surveyor - Service loaded with its legend.
Opened Display Settings; observed Show linked sites visibly checked and Surveyor - Service in map layers and legend.
Captured decisive final and read browser URL before cleanup.
Closed settings with Escape and removed test-added layer. It disappeared immediately but reappeared on the next GIS visit; removal was completed after criterion 2 with a wait.
results.observed: Show linked sites is visibly checked; Surveyor - Service is identifiable in map layers and legend.
results.reason: Recovered add-layer tool timeout; criterion was directly verified after recovery. Initial cleanup removal reappeared on return; subsequent cleanup completed removal.

results.criterion: Changing Show linked sites to the opposite state visibly changes the checkbox state; after closing Display Settings, the same Surveyor layer remains in the layer list and its legend remains available.
steps_taken: Navigated to exact launcher and captured own initial state.
Opened GIS; Surveyor - Service was present after the previous removal reappeared.
Opened its Display Settings and independently observed checked Show linked sites baseline.
Clicked Show linked sites; observed unchecked checkbox and disabled linked-cells checkbox.
Closed settings with Escape; observed same Surveyor - Service map-layer entry and expanded legend.
Captured decisive final and read browser URL.
Reopened settings for cleanup, restored original checked state, closed with Escape and removed test-added layer; waited 3 seconds. Next independent GIS visit showed no loaded Surveyor layer.
results.observed: Show linked sites visibly changed from checked to unchecked. Closing Display Settings retained Surveyor - Service and its available expanded legend.
results.reason: Original checkbox state restored and test-added layer removed.

results.criterion: Reopening Display Settings for the same Surveyor layer shows the changed Show linked sites checkbox state without adding the layer again.
steps_taken: Navigated to exact launcher and captured own initial state.
Opened GIS; no Surveyor layer loaded.
Opened Surveyor add dialog and added layer with default configuration.
Opened Display Settings; independently observed Show linked sites checked.
Clicked Show linked sites and observed unchecked state.
Closed with Escape; same layer and legend remained.
Reopened Display Settings without adding layer again; Show linked sites remained unchecked.
Captured decisive final and read browser URL and checkbox state.
Restored Show linked sites to checked; verified checked snapshot; closed with Escape and removed test-added layer. After 3 seconds no Surveyor - Service entry or legend remained.
results.observed: Reopening Display Settings for the same Surveyor - Service layer retained unchecked Show linked sites without any intervening add-layer action.
results.reason: Original checkbox state restored and test-added layer removed.

conciseReport: All three visible UI criteria passed with independent launcher starts and criterion-specific PNG evidence. Show linked sites began checked, changed to unchecked while retaining the Surveyor layer and legend, and remained unchecked after reopening settings. Final assertion URLs were observed at /gis. The original checked state was restored and the test-added layer removed. An add-layer tool timeout recovered; the first removal reappeared on returning to GIS and was subsequently completed. No saved records were edited.
reason: Completed all three criteria; evidence awaits review.
